theorem conserved_average (c : Conserved V H J) : Conserved V H (averageStress X J) where
  symmetric a b := by
    rw [average_component h, average_component h]
    exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
      (rotate_conserved h K J c).symmetric a b)
  real a b := calc
    _ = ∫ K : Ortho, S.conj H 4 (rotateStress X K J a b) ∂μ :=
      map_average h J (realConjugateComponent H a b)
    _ = ∫ K : Ortho, rotateStress X K J a b ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
        (rotate_conserved h K J c).real a b)
    _ = _ := (average_component h J a b).symm
  divergence b := by
    calc
      _ = divergenceMap V b (averageStress X J) := (divergenceMap_apply V b _).symm
      _ = ∫ K : Ortho, divergenceMap V b (rotateStress X K J) ∂μ :=
        map_average h J ((divergenceMap V b).restrictScalars ℝ)
      _ = ∫ _ : Ortho, (0 : S.Field (4+1)) ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
          (divergenceMap_apply V b _).trans ((rotate_conserved h K J c).divergence b))
      _ = 0 := integral_zero _ _

proof_context.conclusion: `averageStress X J` is symmetric, real and divergence-free, the integrals commuting with the linear maps `component`, `S.conj` and `divergenceMap` via `map_average`.

theorem rotate_conserved {V : DiffPlan S} {H : S.RealSpin} {X : Rotation S}
    (h : X.Laws V H) (K : Ortho) (J : S.Stress) (c : Conserved V H J) :
    Conserved V H (rotateStress X K J) where
  symmetric a b := by
    rw [rotateStress_apply, rotateStress_apply, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [mul_comm (K.val a i), c.symmetric i j]
  real a b := by
    simp only [rotateStress_apply, map_sum, map_smulₛₗ, h.real, c.real]
    simp
  divergence b := by
    rw [← divergenceMap_apply, rotate_divergence h]
    simp only [divergenceMap_apply, c.divergence, map_zero, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

proof_context.conclusion: Each `rotateStress X K J` is symmetric, real and conserved, using the vector law `h.vector` for derivatives (`rotate_divergence`).
